title: E-Commerce Platform
shortDescription: Full-stack eCommerce platform with responsive customer storefront and dedicated admin dashboard.
description: Developed a full-stack eCommerce platform with a responsive customer storefront and dedicated admin dashboard using React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS.

title: Real Estate Marketplace
shortDescription: Full-stack real estate platform enabling users to list, search, filter, and enquire about properties.
description: Developed a full-stack real estate platform enabling users to list, search, filter, and enquire about properties using React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.

title: Mobile Sales Analytics Dashboard (Power BI)
shortDescription: Interactive Power BI dashboard visualizing sales KPIs, product performance, and regional sales trends.
description: Designed interactive dashboards to visualize KPIs, product performance, and regional sales trends. Implemented DAX calculations and data models for dynamic reporting.

title: AI Fake Job Posting Detector
shortDescription: Python-based analytical classification system to detect and identify fraudulent job postings.
description: Developed a Python-based system to analyze and classify job postings, showcasing strong analytical and system design skills.

title: BuildLoop: AI-Powered Product Management Platform
shortDescription: AI-powered product management platform clustering raw feedback into insights, feature roadmaps, and RAG-based code Q&A workspace.
description: Developing an AI-powered product management platform that ingests raw user feedback, clusters it into actionable insights, generates a prioritized feature roadmap, and syncs it with a Kanban board. Building a RAG-based code Q&A workspace using Voyage AI embeddings and Pinecone to enable semantic code search and context-aware developer assistance.

title: Personal Knowledge Base Copilot (RAG)
shortDescription: AI-powered knowledge assistant enabling multi-source document ingestion and conversational question answering via RAG.
description: Developing an AI-powered knowledge assistant that enables users to upload PDFs, Markdown files, notes, Notion exports, and web content for conversational question answering. Building a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using vector embeddings and semantic search to provide context-aware, source-grounded responses from user documents.
